t: 波兰贵族组成了律师协会.
te: Polish nobles form the Bar Confederation.
dz: 波兰贵族组成了律师协会.
de: Polish nobles form the Bar Confederation.

t: 伦敦在约翰·威尔克斯因为"北布里顿"(The North Briton)撰写一篇文章严重地批评…
te: Rioting occurs in London after John Wilkes is imprisoned for writing an article for The North Briton severely criticisi…
dz: 伦敦在约翰·威尔克斯因为"北布里顿"(The North Briton)撰写一篇文章严重地批评了国王乔治三世而入狱后发生骚乱.
de: Rioting occurs in London after John Wilkes is imprisoned for writing an article for The North Briton severely criticising King George III.

t: 小詹姆斯·奥蒂斯在马萨诸塞州总法院的演讲中冒犯了国王和议会.
te: James Otis Jr. offends the King and Parliament in a speech to the Massachusetts General Court.
dz: 小詹姆斯·奥蒂斯在马萨诸塞州总法院的演讲中冒犯了国王和议会.
de: James Otis Jr. offends the King and Parliament in a speech to the Massachusetts General Court.

t: 詹姆斯·库克船长从英国起航,搭乘"奋进号"(HMS Endeavour)起航,开始了他第一次出…
te: Captain James Cook sets sail from England on board HMS Endeavour, starting his first voyage of discovery.
dz: 詹姆斯·库克船长从英国起航,搭乘"奋进号"(HMS Endeavour)起航,开始了他第一次出航的发现.
de: Captain James Cook sets sail from England on board HMS Endeavour, starting his first voyage of discovery.

t: "斯坦维克斯要塞条约"已经签署,条约的目的是调整13个殖民地的1763年"皇家公告"所设定的印…
te: The Treaty of Fort Stanwix is signed, the purpose of which is to adjust the boundary line between Indian lands and whit…
dz: "斯坦维克斯要塞条约"已经签署,条约的目的是调整13个殖民地的1763年"皇家公告"所设定的印第安地与白人定居点之间的分界线.
de: The Treaty of Fort Stanwix is signed, the purpose of which is to adjust the boundary line between Indian lands and white settlements set forth in the Royal Proclamation of 1763 in the Thirteen Colonies.

t: 奴隶船Fredensborg 在挪威的特罗姆亚下沉.
te: The slave ship Fredensborg sinks off Tromøya in Norway.
dz: 奴隶船Fredensborg 在挪威的特罗姆亚下沉.
de: The slave ship Fredensborg sinks off Tromøya in Norway.

t: 第一版大英百科全书出版。
te: The first edition of the Encyclopædia Britannica is published.
dz: 第一版大英百科全书出版。
de: The first edition of the Encyclopædia Britannica is published.

t: 塔克辛国王的加冕是通过被征服成为泰国国王而实现的,并建立了通布里为首都.
te: King Taksin's coronation achieved through conquest as a king of Thailand and established Thonburi as a capital.
dz: 塔克辛国王的加冕是通过被征服成为泰国国王而实现的,并建立了通布里为首都.
de: King Taksin's coronation achieved through conquest as a king of Thailand and established Thonburi as a capital.
